extensions.name: ctx
extensions.description: Unified branch context: name, repo, ticket, and PR

extensions.name: pinch
extensions.description: Open, edit, and ship files changed in the current branch

extensions.name: marry
extensions.description: Create branch, commit, push, and open PR — guided mode, diff browser, delegates PR to the pr extension

extensions.name: torch
extensions.description: Burn local branches except protected ones

extensions.name: rebirth
extensions.description: Hard-reset current branch to match remote origin

extensions.name: cbn
extensions.description: Commit with message auto-generated from branch name (supports scoped monorepos)

extensions.name: quiver
extensions.description: Interactive branch manager with favorites and auto-stash

extensions.name: hotfix
extensions.description: Cherry-pick commits into multiple target branches with PR links

extensions.name: copen
extensions.description: Open modified and staged files in your editor

extensions.name: fresh
extensions.description: Switch to main branch and sync with remote

extensions.name: pr
extensions.description: Create/list PRs — template body and interactive label multi-select

extensions.name: wip
extensions.description: Quick work-in-progress commits with easy undo

extensions.name: sync
extensions.description: Sync current branch with upstream via rebase or merge

extensions.name: standup
extensions.description: Show your recent commits for daily standups

extensions.name: shh
extensions.description: Stage, amend into the last commit, and safe force-push (--force-with-lease)

extensions.name: split
extensions.description: Split a branch into one branch (and PR) per commit — reverse cbn naming
